summary: Iteration 8 covers Emergent Google session auth, Ask GroovLabz AI chat (SSE), profile avatar upload, admin media overrides, and the hero infinity glyph. Backend: 12/12 pytest passing (test_iteration8.py). Google auth: seeded user_sessions doc — GET /api/auth/me with Bearer session_token → 200 correct email; cookie session_token → 200; expired session → 401 'Session expired'; POST /api/auth/google/session missing X-Session-ID → 400, bogus → 401; POST /api/auth/logout with cookie session_token deletes the user_sessions row (verified via mongo). JWT admin@groovlabz.com/admin123 login still returns 200+token and /me works. AI: POST /api/ai/chat streams text/event-stream deltas; response mentions 'Lightning V' and '399' (Bluetooth guitar); GET /api/ai/history/{session} returns [user, assistant] in order; second turn ('Is that guitar good for stage use?') yields a 4-message history (context preserved). Validation: mode='bogus' 422, empty message 422, short session_id 422. Avatar: unauth 401; .txt 400; PNG upload 200 with {picture:'/api/files/<id>'}; /api/auth/me reflects new picture; GET <url> 200 image/png; /api/shop/products/galaxy-v/reviews shows admin's review with author_picture equal to new URL. Media overrides: PUT /api/admin/media/product/groovwah 200; product/list image swap to /api/files/..; PUT app/groovbox 200 and /api/media-overrides has 'app:groovbox'; product/notaproduct 404; product/kit-lightning-v-strings-blue 404; non-admin 403; unauth 401; DELETE product/groovwah 200 and image reverts to /shop/groovwah.jpg. Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): hero-infinity shows '∞' + 'From a trip to a riff'; ai-chat-toggle visible on /, /shop, /apps/groovsesh; toggle opens ai-chat-panel; support/gear/riff mode buttons change ai-empty-hint text; typing 'What is the cheapest amp you sell?' → assistant streams 'The cheapest amp we sell is the GroovAmp Go Portable (7 W) for $99.00.' within a few seconds; localStorage.gl_ai_session set (web-…); after reload+reopen, previous user+assistant messages restored. Google: /login and /register show google-signin-button; clicking navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/account (URL decoded matches); /account#session_id=fake123 renders auth-callback then redirects to /login (backend 401). Seeded-session browser test: cookie session_token + localStorage.gl_token → /account renders account-page for the Google Tester (greeting 'Hey Google', email test.google.ftend@example.com, nav shows Google) without redirect. Avatar: admin login → /account shows avatar-upload; set_input_files uploads PNG → avatar-image src contains /api/files/..; nav-avatar appears; /shop/galaxy-v shows review-author-avatar with the same /api/files/.. src. Admin media: /account shows admin-media-link → /admin/media renders admin-media-page with 5 media-row-app-* and 16 media-row-product-* rows; media-row-app-groovbox shows 'Custom upload' and has media-reset-app-groovbox; /apps/groovbox app-screen-groovbox img src == /api/files/<id> (override); homepage app-card-groovbox img also uses that URL. Uploading via media-input-product-strings-blue flips row to 'Custom upload'; clicking media-reset-product-strings-blue reverts row to 'Default image' and /api/shop/products/strings-blue.image back to /shop/strings-blue.jpg. Logged-out /admin/media → /login redirect. Cleanup: DELETE app/groovbox override done, test users/sessions removed. No blocking console errors after fix.

design_issues.screen: /apps/groovbox (and other apps that share JamNow slides)
issues: React key warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key /jamnow/groovbox-home.jpg' in the AppScreen or slide list — non-blocking but should use unique keys per slide.

action_items: FIXED (in this iteration) — /app/frontend/src/pages/Account.jsx used <AvatarUpload /> without importing it, causing a Runtime error 'AvatarUpload is not defined' on /account which broke the entire authenticated dashboard (avatar upload, admin-media-link, seeded Google session render). Added: import AvatarUpload from '../components/AvatarUpload'. Please verify and keep this import in place.
Minor: fix duplicate React key '/jamnow/groovbox-home.jpg' in AppScreen slide list (add unique keys, e.g. include index or app id).
Ongoing: server.py is 1232 lines (>700 guideline). Recommend routers/ split (auth, ai, uploads, admin_media, shop, payments).
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user cleanly supports both JWT (access_token cookie or Bearer) and Emergent session_token (cookie or Bearer) via a fallback path; expired-session branch returns 401 with 'Session expired'. Correct.

google_session: 400 on missing X-Session-ID, 401 on Emergent verification failure, upserts user by email, upserts user_sessions with 7-day expiry, sets both session_token and access_token cookies (httponly, secure, samesite=none). Meets playbook.
logout deletes the user_sessions doc matching cookie session_token AND clears both cookies. Correct.
AiChatRequest uses Pydantic constraints (session_id min_length=8, message min_length=1, mode pattern) so 422 is enforced by FastAPI — no manual validation branch needed.
ai_chat persists both user and (concatenated) assistant messages in ai_messages and passes trimmed history[-20:] as context, so multi-turn coherence works. Verified with 'that guitar' follow-up.
upload_avatar validates content_type via ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES, size cap 5MB, and cascades users.picture + reviews.author_picture — exactly per spec.

MEDIA_KEYS pre-computes valid product/app targets (excluding bundles), so bundle IDs and unknown IDs correctly 404 at PUT. _apply_product_overrides also supplies bundle images from their first included product, which keeps kit thumbnails consistent even when a component gets a custom image.
AdminMedia UI computes overrides through the media.js in-memory cache; full page navigation is required (spec noted). Verified caches refreshed via page.goto instead of client-side nav.
Frontend Runtime error 'AvatarUpload is not defined' on /account was a missing default import in Account.jsx — fixed here.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scenarios after AvatarUpload import fix

test_credentials: admin@groovlabz.com / admin123 (JWT). Seeded Google session: cookie session_token=<token>, localStorage.gl_token=<token> — spec in /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Seeded and cleaned up per test: users.insertOne({id: google-test-..., email: test.google.<rand>@example.com, name: 'Google Tester', role: user, auth_provider: google}) + user_sessions.insertOne({session_token: test_session_<rand>, expires_at: +7d}). All test users/sessions deleted at end. Admin avatar picture left in place (allowed). All product/app media overrides deleted at end (verified GET /api/media-overrides == {}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview> MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_iteration8.py. All 12 pass. /api/media-overrides is empty at end. The reviews endpoint returns {reviews: [...], count, average} (a dict, NOT a bare list) — update assertions accordingly. When testing seeded Google session in the browser, set both the session_token cookie AND localStorage.gl_token to the same token, then goto /account. Google redirect URL is https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/account (note '/oauth/' path prefix).
